marketing.footerTagline: The all-in-one platform for tattoo studios — scheduling, deposits, consent, billing, and client communication in one place.
marketing.pricingTitle: Plans that scale with your studio
marketing.pricingSubtitle: Transparent monthly pricing. Every plan includes hosting, updates, and full documentation. No setup fees on Starter and Studio.
marketing.notSurePlanBody: Tell us about your studio and we'll recommend the right setup — or start a free trial on Starter or Studio.
marketing.pricesGbp: Prices in GBP, billed monthly. Stripe card fees apply separately to client payments. Questions?

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Run bookings professionally with up to 3 artists on your schedule.

studio.name: Studio
studio.description: The full Velbok toolkit for busy studios — up to 6 artists and front-desk staff.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For established shops with larger teams — up to 10 artists plus priority support.

faq.trialA: All plans include a 14-day free trial. Choose a plan on the subscribe page — you'll enter card details on Stripe but won't be charged until the trial ends.
faq.includedA: Secure cloud hosting, product updates, access to documentation, SSL, and data stored on isolated Supabase infrastructure per studio.
faq.stripeFeesA: No. Card processing fees are charged by Stripe on top of your subscription. Velbok integrates with your Stripe account for deposits and invoices.
faq.switchA: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade as your team grows — Starter (3 artists), Studio (6), or Enterprise (10).
faq.migrateQ: Do you help migrate from my current system?
faq.migrateA: Studio and Enterprise plans include client CSV import in the app. Enterprise includes hands-on migration assistance for bookings and records.

landing.heroSubtitle: {{platform}} is the all-in-one platform for scheduling, deposits, consent forms, billing, and client communication — so you spend less time on admin and more time tattooing.
landing.featuresSubtitle: One platform from first enquiry to healed tattoo — no patchwork of spreadsheets, DMs, and payment links.
landing.featureScheduleDesc: Day and week views, artist filters, booking types, and real-time updates across your whole team.
landing.featureCrmDesc: Import clients from CSV, track history, conduct notes, VIP flags, and linked customer accounts.
landing.featureDepositsDesc: Collect deposits at booking, send payment links, and reconcile paid status on the schedule.
landing.featureConsentDesc: Tattoo and piercing consent forms with e-signatures, PDF export, and audit trail.
landing.featureInboxDesc: Centralised messaging with clients — threads, media, and email notifications when configured.
landing.featureBillingDesc: Create invoices, line-item templates, Stripe checkout, and company-level billing records.
landing.featureStockDesc: Track supplies, supplier links, and stock requests from artists on the floor.
landing.featureStencilDesc: Generate and refine stencils to speed up design prep (when enabled for your studio).
landing.step1Body: Get your Velbok studio instance configured with your branding, artists, and services.
landing.step2Body: Book clients on the schedule, take deposits, send consent links, and message from one dashboard.
landing.step3Body: Customers view bookings, pay deposits, complete consent, and chat through their portal.
landing.audiencesTitle: Built for everyone in the studio
landing.ctaBody: Explore plans, read the docs, or sign in to your studio app to get started today.
landing.faq1Q: Is Velbok only for tattoo studios?
landing.faq1A: Velbok is built for tattoo and piercing studios with consent workflows, multi-artist scheduling, and deposit handling — but any appointment-based creative studio can use the core platform.
landing.faq2Q: Do my clients need an account?
landing.faq2A: Clients can receive links for deposits and consent without a full account. Optional customer accounts unlock the portal for bookings, messages, and invoices.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use my own branding?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Each studio deployment supports custom shop name, colours, contact details, and portal theming.
landing.faq4A: Velbok runs on Supabase (PostgreSQL) with row-level security. Each studio instance is isolated — your data stays yours.
